title: PM daily scratchpad - Smart Routing v1 launch
content:
Quick plan for today — launch prep for Smart Routing v1

Top priorities:
- Finalize PRD edits (open comments from SRE + infra) — aim to submit by 3pm PT
- Confirm canary rollout plan with SRE (RD-4021) and get autoscaler thresholds
- Smoke tests + perf baseline for quantized-variant on nv4s (target p95 latency < 120ms)
- Stakeholder sync 10:30am with Luis (SRE) and Priya (Console); walk through rollback playbook

PRD edits notes:
- Added section: 'Fallback behavior' — when model variant unavailable, route to CPU small-model w/ latency warning
- Need to clarify telemetry points: per-request model_variant, batch_id, cache_hit
- TODO: add exact metrics to measure for QA (latency, error-rate, token-cost)
- Action: @Priya to add dashboard mockups (linked: CONFLUENCE:prd-smart-routing-v1)

Launch checklist (pre-launch):
- [ ] Canaries running (5% -> 25% -> 100%): define time windows
- [ ] Load test at 1.5x expected qps with KV-cache warm
- [ ] Observability: traces, token cost breakdown, model-fallback alerts
- [ ] Rollback criteria documented and tested
- [ ] Customer communications drafted (support KB + status page blurb)

Follow-ups / people:
- Luis M: confirm autoscaler thresholds + cost guardrails (follow-up in RD-4030)
- Priya N: console rollout flags + per-route UI hooks
- Eng on Quantization: need guidance on expected p99 regression (acceptable < 2% BLEU / ORPM)
- Security: check KMS integration for private deployments (ask security team)

Risks & unknowns:
- If NV4 memory fragmentation affects batch sizes, latency will spike — need fallback policy earlier
- Third-party auth delay in private deployments might add up to 50ms — include in latency budget

Quick timeline:
- 09:00 standup
- 10:30 stakeholder sync
- 13:00 perf regression triage
- 15:00 PRD final edits done
- 16:00 submit canary request to SRE

Notes to self:
- Keep PR comments inline; call out any breaking changes with bold
- If SRE asks for extended canary, negotiate reduced traffic and extended monitoring window
- Remember to snapshot model artifacts and log the hash in PR

Raw links:
- Jira: RD-4021, RD-4030
- GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/realtime-routing/pull/87
- Confluence: prd-smart-routing-v1

End.
